[list]

notes.title: Summer update notes for July 3rd
notes.content:
[Event]

    The Summer event has officially begun! Enjoy the festivities and take part in exciting activities.

[Experience]

    Experience gain has been doubled during the Summer event. Level up faster and enhance your skills!

[Battles]

    The concept of Legion quantity has been removed. Instead, every battle will now showcase the Legion at its full strength. Prepare for epic encounters in every battle!

[Graphics]

    Graphic optimization has been significantly improved. Enjoy a smoother and more visually appealing gaming experience.

[Character Balance]

   Templar:
        The health points (HP) of Templar have been increased by 200. Strengthen your Templar's resilience in combat.

    Titan Warrior:
        Titan Warriors now gain 5 points in Dexterity. Enhance your Titan Warrior's agility and precision.

    Red Mage:
        The health points (HP) of Red Mage have been increased by 100. Boost your Red Mage's survivability on the battlefield.
        The fire damage of Red Mage has been increased by 10. Unleash more destructive flames upon your enemies.

    Alchemist:

        The defense (Def) of Alchemist has been reduced by 5. Trade some defense for increased offensive potential.

        Cold resistance for Alchemist has been doubled. With improved resistance, endure freezing attacks more effectively.

    Reaper:

        The luck stat of Reaper has been reduced by 2. 

        Cold damage for Reaper has been increased by 10. Freeze your foes with even greater intensity.

        Fire resistance for Reaper has been doubled. Become highly resistant to scorching attacks.

Please note that these changes have been implemented to enhance gameplay balance and provide an exciting and challenging experience for all players. Enjoy the Summer event and have a legendary time in battles!
